pokedexEntries.sw: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

pokedexEntries.sh: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.vi: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee's wings, it'll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

pokedexEntries.za: This valiant Pokémon will challenge any foe, no matter how mighty. Even if that backfires and Rookidee loses, it grows from the experience.
